subject: Death Mountain Trail
text: Smashing the rock next to the bomb flower with the Megaton Hammer at night reveals Gold Skulltula 079.

evidence.quote: During the night you should hear something crawling around here, equip the Megaton Hammer and break the rock beside the bomb flower to find GOLD SKULLTULA [079].

subject: Biggoron
text: Presenting the Broken Goron's Sword to Biggoron prompts him to give Link the Prescription for King Zora's Eyedrops.

evidence.quote: Make your way up the climbing wall and on your right at the top is the Biggoron.  Use the Broken Goron's Sword in front of him and he'll recognize it.  He says that before he can repair anything, he's going to need some Eyedrops from King Zora.  In return he gives you the PRESCRIPTION you need.

subject: King Zora
text: Using the Prescription in front of King Zora yields the Eyeball Frog, which must be delivered promptly to the Lake Hylia Laboratory.

evidence.quote: stand on the platform before the king and use the Prescription.  He will give you the EYEBALL FROG which is needed in order to fill the prescription, get it to the Lake Hylia Laboratory as soon as possible.

subject: Lake Hylia Laboratory
text: Handing the Eyeball Frog to the old man in the Lake Hylia Laboratory rewards Link with the World's Finest Eye Drops.

evidence.quote: Head for the lab and go inside, use the frog beside the old man here (approximate time remaining: plenty).  He'll give you WORLD'S FINEST EYE DROPS.

subject: Biggoron
text: Delivering the Eyedrops to Biggoron atop the mountain wall yields the Claim Check for the sword.

evidence.quote: Climb the wall after they are dead and use the Eyedrops in front of the Biggoron to get the CLAIM CHECK for the sword.

subject: Biggoron
text: Playing the Sun's Song roughly five times after handing over the Claim Check allows Link to receive the unbreakable Biggoron's Sword.

evidence.quote: Play the Sun's Song about five times or so and speak to him again to get the BIGGORON'S SWORD.

subject: Biggoron's Sword
text: Biggoron's Sword matches the attack power of the Giant's Knife without breaking, but prevents Link from using a shield simultaneously.

evidence.quote: The power of the sword is equivalent to that of the Giant's Knife except that unlike the knife, it cannot break.  Unfortunately you can't use it along with your shield, but with

subject: Horseback Archery
text: The Gerudo Fortress shooting range costs twenty Rupees per round, requires Epona, and can only be entered during the daytime.

evidence.quote: The shooting range is located in the Gerudo Fortress, you must have Epona and head to the eastern area where all of the targets are located to begin.  The game can only be played during the day, the Gerudo to speak to will not appear at night.  Make sure you are on your horse when you speak to her and the game will begin.  The cost to play one round is twenty Rupees.

subject: Horseback Archery
text: Each Horseback Archery attempt gives Link twenty arrows while Epona gallops on an automatic path, with target thresholds set at 1000 and 1500 points.

evidence.quote: You don't control the horse, it moves automatically and you simply fire.  You are given twenty arrows each time you try.  Prizes are awarded for 1000 and 1500 points.

subject: Horseback Archery
text: Hitting pots earns 100 points each, while archery targets reward 100 points for the centre, 60 points for the middle ring, and 30 points for the edge.

evidence.quote: aim your bow and fire arrows at every single pot you pass, each one of them is worth 100 points.  After passing the last pot turn yourself forward and aim up at the target ahead of you.  Hitting the centre is worth 100 points, the outer circle is 60 points and the edge is 30 points.

subject: Horseback Archery
text: Scoring 1000 points in Horseback Archery awards Piece of Heart 033.

evidence.quote: Your prize for successfully accumulating 1000 points is a PIECE OF HEART [033].

subject: Gerudo Training Ground
text: Accessing the Gerudo Training Ground requires paying ten Rupees to the guard on the southeastern side of Gerudo Fortress.

evidence.quote: The Gerudo Training Ground is located in the Gerudo Fortress, after you can walk around there freely, speak to the person on the southeastern side.  She'll let you enter the training ground for just a mere ten Rupees.

subject: Entrance Room
text: Shooting the eyeball switch located above the entrance door spawns a chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: Equip the Fairy Bow and do a 180 degree turn, above the door where you entered there is an eyeball switch, fire an arrow at it to spawn a small chest containing BLUE RUPEE.

subject: Stalfos Room
text: Defeating the two Stalfos within the one-minute limit spawns a chest holding a Small Key.

evidence.quote: There are two Stalfos enemies in this room and you need to defeat them before the time limit of one minute runs out, obviously make sure you're using the Biggoron's Sword for this.  After killing them both a chest appears containing SMALL KEY, pick it up and go through the door beside the chest to enter the next hall.

subject: Silver Rupee Boulder Hall
text: Collecting all five Silver Rupees in the boulder room must be completed within a time limit of one minute and thirty seconds.

evidence.quote: In here you have one minute and thirty seconds to collect all the Silver Rupees.

subject: Wolfos Room
text: Defeating all four wolf enemies spawns a small chest containing Arrows.

evidence.quote: Defeat the four wolf enemies in this room and then open the small chest appears to get a bunch of ARROWS.

subject: Statue Eye Room
text: Lighting up all four statue eyes in a circle with the Fairy Bow spawns a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Jump down onto the platform in the centre and equip the Fairy Bow.  Shoot the eyeball of the statue and make your way around from left to right in a circle, shooting the eyeballs as you go along.  When all four of them are lit up a chest appears containing a SMALL KEY.

subject: Statue Hammer Room
text: Defeating all enemies in the statue hammer room spawns a chest containing Arrows.

evidence.quote: There are a number of enemies in this room, all you really have to do is defeat them all and a chest will appear containing ARROWS.

subject: Statue Hammer Room
text: Stepping on the floor switch after smashing the statues lowers the flames around a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Shoot the eyeball switch to unlock the door and step on the button to lower the fire in the middle and allow you to open the chest for a SMALL KEY.

subject: Underwater Room
text: Gathering all the underwater Silver Rupees using the Iron Boots and Longshot unlocks a small chest at the surface containing the fourth Small Key.

evidence.quote: When this is over, swim back up to the top and open the small chest to acquire the fourth SMALL KEY.

subject: Lizalfos Room
text: Destroying the laser pillar with a Bomb after eliminating the two lizard enemies spawns a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: When the two lizards are defeated, bomb the laser pillar and a chest appears with a SMALL KEY in it.

subject: Song of Time Platform
text: Playing the Song of Time creates blocks to reach an upper doorway leading to the sixth Small Key.

evidence.quote: Play the Song of Time (right, A, down, right, A, down) and some blocks will appear here.  use the Hover Boots to reach them and climb up.  Grab the sixth SMALL KEY and go through the door.

subject: Upper Storage Hall
text: Turning right past the door reveals a chest containing Arrows.

evidence.quote: Make a right here and it leads to a chest containing ARROWS.

subject: Upper Storage Hall
text: Opening the chest directly across from the doorway rewards Link with a Bombchu.

evidence.quote: Directly across from the door where you entered is a chest with a BOMBCHU in it.

subject: Locked Door Maze
text: Unlocking two consecutive doors on the left in the maze leads to a chest with a Purple Rupee.

evidence.quote: use two Small Keys to go through the locked door on your left and then the one after it as well, now you're down to four.  Open the chest to get a PURPLE RUPEE here.

subject: Locked Door Maze
text: Proceeding through the next two locked doors reveals a small chest with a Red Rupee.

evidence.quote: Continue through the next locked door and the one after it, open the small chest containing a RED RUPEE.

subject: Locked Door Maze
text: Unlocking the subsequent door leads to a chest holding Arrows.

evidence.quote: Continue through the next door and open the chest to get ARROWS.

subject: Ceiling Hidden Room
text: Climbing the hidden fence wall spotted in the ceiling using the Lens of Truth leads to a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Proceed through the door on the left which you unlocked and take a look at the ceiling with the Lens of Truth equipped, there is a hole up there.  Climb the fence wall and here you will find a chest containing a SMALL KEY.

subject: Queen Gohma
text: Targeting Queen Gohma's eye and firing a Deku Seed with the Fairy Slingshot stuns her, leaving her vulnerable to sword strikes.

evidence.quote: Hold the L/Z button to target her eye and tap the Fairy Slingshot button to fire a Deku Seed right into it, stunning the boss.  While the boss is stunned, run up to her and begin to slash her with your sword as many times as you possibly can.

subject: Queen Gohma
text: When Gohma scales the ceiling and drops three eggs, striking each egg once before it hatches eliminates the offspring.

evidence.quote: After a few seconds she'll drop three eggs down directly below where she is on the ceiling.  You now have a small amount of time to go and strike those eggs, one single hit will kill them however if you are not fast enough they will hatch into those little one eyed enemies you fought before.

subject: Queen Gohma
text: The ideal moment to shoot Gohma's eye is when she rears up on her back legs and her eye turns red.

evidence.quote: Target Gohma's eye and let her get close, while she is up on her back legs and the eye is red that is the best time to fire.

subject: King Dodongo
text: Standing on the 45 degree slope bordering the path and central lava grants total immunity to all of King Dodongo's attacks.

evidence.quote: First of all you should acquaint yourself with the little 45 degree slope between the path you are on and the lava in the middle, while standing on this slope you are immune to all his attacks.

subject: King Dodongo
text: Tossing a Bomb into King Dodongo's mouth while he inhales knocks him down, creating an opening for a Jump Attack.

evidence.quote: What you have to do is lift a Bomb above your head while the boss is breathing in, and then throw it into his mouth.  When the Bomb explodes the boss drops down and that is your chance to hit him exactly once.  Use the Jump Attack when he falls.

subject: King Dodongo
text: Dodging King Dodongo's roll attack is accomplished by standing on the sloping ledge.

evidence.quote: After the boss gets up he will roll down and around the corner, dodge this attack easily by standing on that little sloping area like I told you.

subject: King Dodongo
text: King Dodongo requires only four standard hits or three Jump Attacks to be defeated.

evidence.quote: It should take only four hits to kill the boss with normal attacks, and as little as three with the Jump Attack.  He will never be able to use his fire breath as long as you always throw a Bomb into his mouth.

subject: Horseback Archery
text: Reaching 1500 points in Horseback Archery awards the Biggest Quiver.

evidence.quote: Your prize for managing to get 1500 points, which is actually quite difficult, is the BIGGEST QUIVER which increases your maximum arrow carrying

subject: Central Treasure Room
text: The final locked room holds a giant chest containing the Ice Arrow.

evidence.quote: Inside the giant chest is the ICE ARROW, like the Fire Arrow it is a special elemental type of arrow you can shoot using the Fairy
